response.rationale: The apparel item was delivered 10 days ago (within the 30-day window) and is not final sale (final_sale is null/not True). No higher-priority rule applies: it is not final sale (RET-012), not defective (RET-020), no goodwill grant (RET-050), no fraud hold (RET-051), and it is not electronics (RET-002/003). Thus RET-007 controls and the return is eligible.
